summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC, as depositor, and Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-D Owner Trust closed an auto-loan securitization on October 15, 2026, issuing six classes of asset-backed notes totaling roughly $1.90 billion, spanning Class A-1 through Class A-4 plus Class B. Under a Receivables Purchase Agreement, Toyota Motor Credit Corporation sold retail installment contracts to TAFR LLC, which then transferred them to the Trust under a Sale and Servicing Agreement; Citibank, N.A. serves as indenture trustee and TMCC as servicer. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation.
